summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation and inventory reservation supporting atomic reservations, priority dispatching, idempotent order processing, and input immutability.

requirements.description: All lines of an order must be reserved atomically together; repeated SKU lines are aggregated before stock checking, and insufficient stock rejects the reservation without modifying stock.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: An initial inventory stock and an order containing one or more lines with possibly repeated SKUs
acceptance.when: The reservation is evaluated against available stock
acceptance.then: Either all requested quantities are atomically deducted from remaining stock or no deduction occurs if any SKU has insufficient or unknown stock

requirements.description: Valid expedited priority orders must be processed before normal priority orders, preserving the original arrival order within each priority category.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: A list of orders with expedited and normal priorities
acceptance.when: Orders are fulfilled against available warehouse stock
acceptance.then: Expedited orders are allocated before normal orders, maintaining original input order within each priority tier

requirements.description: Order identifiers are unique and idempotent: the first occurrence of an ID claims it, and subsequent duplicate IDs are ignored entirely.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: A sequence of incoming orders containing duplicate order IDs
acceptance.then: Only the first occurrence of each order ID is processed, and all subsequent occurrences of that ID are ignored completely

requirements.description: Invalid order lines and orders with missing or invalid IDs or priorities are rejected without modifying stock, and caller input objects remain unmutated.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: Input stock and order objects with potentially invalid lines or order metadata
acceptance.then: Invalid lines or orders are rejected with appropriate failure reasons, remaining stock is unchanged for failed reservations, and input objects are not mutated

assumptions: Stock levels are nonnegative safe integers keyed by nonempty SKU strings on a plain object.
Order line quantities are positive safe integers keyed by nonempty SKU strings.
Orders with missing or invalid IDs are rejected as invalid_order with id null and do not claim an ID.
First occurrences of orders with invalid priorities claim their IDs and are rejected as invalid_order.
Failed reservations do not alter remaining stock, and input objects are never mutated.
